info.name: AllianceTrading API
info.description:
All backend APIs, split into User (mobile app) and Admin (console).

Quick start:
1. User > Auth > Request OTP, read the OTP from the server console, then Verify OTP (saves userToken).
2. Admin > Auth > Login with email + password (saves adminToken).

IDs returned by list/create calls are saved into collection variables (userId, paymentAccountId, investmentId, ...). Edit them in the collection Variables tab when needed.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit login OTP to the mobile number. Locally the OTP is printed in the server console. Public.
Verifies the OTP. Creates the user on first login (newUser=true) and returns access + refresh tokens. Saves userToken. Replaces any other active session for this user.
Exchanges the refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair (rotation). Use when the 15-minute access token expires.
Revokes the current session.
Minimum supported app version (force-update check). Public.
Saves the device push notification token for this user.

Submits identity details: full name, DOB (18+), full PAN and full Aadhaar (Verhoeff-checked). Moves user to KYC_SUBMITTED. Allowed only from REGISTERED or after an admin rejection (no edits once submitted/approved). PAN and Aadhaar are stored encrypted.
Returns the user's KYC status and masked PAN/Aadhaar.

Adds the payout bank account (PENDING_VERIFICATION). Also used to CHANGE bank/UPI details: the current verified account keeps receiving payouts until an admin verifies the new one, and a change to a verified account starts a 48h cooling-off during which withdrawals are blocked. accountType: SAVINGS | CURRENT | SALARY. proofDocumentId is optional.
Returns the user's bank accounts with masked account numbers.
Mobile, account status, KYC summary and current bank account.
Home screen data: principal, profit, held balance and live investment.
Transaction history, newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor as cursor for the next page.
The UPI ID, payee and amount the admin assigned to this user. Available after account approval.
UPI QR code image for the assigned account and amount.
Uploads a screenshot of the UPI payment (JPEG/PNG/PDF, max 5 MB). Choose the file in the Body tab. Saves documentId. Needs MinIO/R2 storage running.
Downloads a document the user uploaded.
Declares that the assigned amount was paid, with the payment proof. Creates a PENDING_VERIFICATION investment. Idempotency-Key makes retries safe.
All of the user's investments and their status.
Calculates fee and net amount for a withdrawal. withdrawalType: PROFIT | PRINCIPAL (partial amount allowed; debits tranches oldest-first). The quote expires after a short time.
Creates a withdrawal from a quote and holds the amount. Only one open withdrawal per user.
All of the user's withdrawal requests.
Cancels a withdrawal that is still REQUESTED and releases the held amount.
Opens a support ticket with a first message.
User's tickets, most recent activity first.
Ticket with all messages.
Adds a user message to the ticket (reopens it if resolved).

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin console APIs. Authenticated with {{adminToken}} (ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN).

request.description: Admin login with email and password. Returns access + refresh tokens plus an admin object {id, email, displayName, role}, and saves adminToken. 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. Public.

Any signed-in admin. newPassword 10-100 chars and different from the current one. Wrong current password returns 400 INVALID_CREDENTIALS and counts towards the login lockout. Revokes all sessions of this admin on every device and returns fresh tokens (saves adminToken). Audit ADMIN_PASSWORD_CHANGED.
Revokes the admin session.

stats (activeInvestors, fundsInvested, profitCredited, pendingActions), actionCenter counts (kycPending, investmentPending, withdrawalOpen, supportOpen, bankPending, pnlAwaitingMyApproval, total) and todayDistribution (sessionDate, total, recipients, eligible). IST day/month boundaries; pnlAwaitingMyApproval is per signed-in admin.
Recent audit entries, optionally filtered by entity.
Paged member list with KYC, bank, balance and live investment. search matches mobile or name. status: REGISTERED | KYC_SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | SUSPENDED.
Full member record: KYC, bank accounts, investments, payment assignment, balances.
Member's transaction history (cursor paging).
Blocks login and revokes sessions; the previous status is restored on reactivation.
Lifts a suspension.
Members waiting for approval with masked PAN/Aadhaar, bank account and payment assignment. Saves the first userId.
Shows the full PAN for manual verification. Audited as a PII view.
Shows the full Aadhaar for manual verification. Audited as a PII view.
Approves KYC, verifies the pending bank account and assigns the UPI account + amount the member must pay. Run Payment Accounts > List first to fill paymentAccountId.
Same as approve, but enters new UPI details instead of picking a saved account. saveToList=true also saves it to the payment account list.
Rejects the KYC with a reason shown to the member.

status: PENDING_VERIFICATION (default) | VERIFIED | REJECTED | REPLACED. Paged, newest first: PageResponse { items, page, size, totalItems, totalPages }; page is 0-based, size 1..100 (default 20). Saves the first id.
One bank account by id (AdminBankAccountResponse), for side panels and deep links.
Full account number for payouts. Audited.
Marks a bank account (e.g. a replacement account) as VERIFIED.
Rejects a bank account with a reason.
Saved company UPI accounts shown in the approval dropdown. status: ACTIVE | ARCHIVED. Saves the first id.
Returns { defaultAmount, defaultPaymentAccountId } (either may be null) from the payment setting. The approval form pre-selects defaultPaymentAccountId and pre-fills defaultAmount.
Saves a new company UPI account. Active immediately.

Removes the account from the dropdown. Existing assignments keep working. 409 PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_IN_USE if it is the current default or referenced by a scheduled default change (choose another default in Settings first).
UPI account + amount currently assigned to the member.
Reassigns the member's UPI account and/or amount (the old assignment is kept as history).
The UPI QR image the member sees.

status: PENDING_VERIFICATION (default) | ACTIVE | REJECTED | CLOSED. Paged, newest first: PageResponse { items, page, size, totalItems, totalPages }; page is 0-based, size 1..100 (default 20). Rows include expectedVpa and expectedAmount from the payment assignment (null if none). Saves the first id.
One investment by id (AdminInvestmentResponse, incl. expectedVpa and expectedAmount), for side panels and deep links.
Confirms the payment was received: activates the investment and posts the deposit to the ledger. No request body.
Rejects the payment claim with a reason.

Admin upload (JPEG/PNG/PDF, max 5 MB). docType PAYOUT_PROOF needs ownerUserId (the member); PNL_EVIDENCE or PAYMENT_QR must not send it. Use the returned id in mark-paid, P&L batch (evidenceDocumentId) or payment account (qrDocumentId).
Other active admins who can approve your P&L batch (excludes you and disabled admins). Only for the approver dropdown; use Admin directory for id -> email lookups. Saves the first id.

valueType FIXED: every target member receives exactly `amount` rupees once, however many investments they hold (negative = loss); the server splits it across the member's active investments pro-rata by remaining principal. targetType ALL = every member with an active investment; MEMBER (userId) = one selected member, send one line per member. controlTotal is optional: the server computes it (e.g. 200 x 3 members = 600) and, if sent, it must match. Approval is refused if the members change after creation.

Each member gets their total remaining principal x percentage / 100 (e.g. 1 = +1%, -0.5 = -0.5%), rounded to the paisa, then split across their active investments pro-rata. controlTotal is computed by the server (optional; if sent it must match). Lines can target ALL or one MEMBER (userId). Check Preview before approval; approval is refused if members' active investments changed after creation.

Same body as create (FIXED or PERCENTAGE; approverAdminId optional). Runs the same validation and per-investment calculation but saves nothing. Returns controlTotal, largeChangeThresholdPct and each investment's amount, resulting balance, fullName, mobile and largeChange (true when the change is more than 10% of principal); warnings holds batch-level messages only. Errors such as a loss-floor breach are returned the same way create would return them. Call it as the admin types to show real totals.

status (optional): DRAFT | APPROVED | REJECTED. valueType (optional): FIXED | PERCENTAGE. assignedToMe=true shows drafts waiting for my approval. Paged, newest first: PageResponse { items, page, size, totalItems, totalPages }; page is 0-based, size 1..100 (default 20).

One batch by id (BatchResponse: id, status, batchType, valueType, sessionDate, controlTotal, makerId, assignedCheckerId, checkerId, notes, createdAt, decidedAt). Use for the approver preview and allocations pages instead of listing all batches.

Per-investment amounts the batch will post, with fullName, mobile and largeChange (true when the change is more than 10% of principal; threshold in largeChangeThresholdPct). warnings holds batch-level messages only (active investments changed since the batch was created). Approver should review this before approving.
Per-investment amounts posted by an approved batch.
Must be called by the assigned approver (log in as that admin). Posts P&L to member ledgers.
Assigned approver rejects the batch.

status (optional, omit for all): REQUESTED | APPROVED | CANCELLED | REJECTED | PAID | PAYOUT_FAILED. Paged, newest first: PageResponse { items, page, size, totalItems, totalPages }; page is 0-based, size 1..100 (default 20). Each row has the member (userId, fullName, mobile), bank snapshot (bankAccountId, holder, masked number, IFSC, UPI ID), approvedBy/secondApprovedBy, secondApprovalRequired and awaitingSecondApproval. Full account number: Bank Accounts > Reveal full account number with bankAccountId. Saves the first id.
One withdrawal by id (AdminWithdrawalResponse), for side panels and deep links.
First approval.
Required by a different admin when the amount is above SECOND_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD.
Rejects and releases the held amount.
Records the bank transfer. payoutUtr and payoutProofDocumentId are optional.
Records a failed bank transfer so it can be retried.
status: OPEN | RESOLVED. priority: NORMAL | HIGH.
Ticket with all messages and member info.
Admin reply; the member is notified.
Marks the ticket RESOLVED.
Reopens a resolved ticket.
priority: NORMAL | HIGH.

item.name: Settings
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only (403 otherwise). Saves are final (no second admin); effectiveFrom now applies immediately, a later time schedules the change.

request.description: Returns { payment, fees, app, scheduled[] }: payment is { id, fixedAmount, paymentAccount, effectiveFrom }; effective values plus scheduled changes (soonest first). scheduled[] items: { kind: PAYMENT|FEE|APP, id, fixedAmount, paymentAccount { id, label, vpa, payeeName, hasUploadedQr }, withdrawalType, feePct, key, value, effectiveFrom, createdBy, createdAt }. Use scheduled[].id with Cancel scheduled setting.

Direct save of default investment amount + default payment account. Send exactly one of paymentAccountId (an ACTIVE saved account; archived -> 409 ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION) or newAccount { label?, vpa, payeeName, qrDocumentId? } (created in the same transaction and always saved to the account list; UPI ID already saved -> 400). Both or neither -> 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. The account's QR (uploaded, or generated from its UPI ID) is used. Run Payment Accounts > List first to fill paymentAccountId. effectiveFrom required, now or later (up to 5 min past accepted as now; earlier -> 400 VALIDATION_FAILED). Returns { id, status, effectiveFrom }; status ACTIVE (effectiveFrom <= now) or SCHEDULED. Audited as SETTING_CHANGED (old/new paymentAccountId and vpa).
Direct save of a withdrawal fee as a fraction (0.02 = 2%). withdrawalType: PROFIT | PRINCIPAL. effectiveFrom now or later; returns { id, status: ACTIVE|SCHEDULED, effectiveFrom }.

key (lowercase): min_profit_withdrawal (rupees) | principal_withdrawal_enabled (true/false) | bank_change_cooloff_hours (hours) | withdrawal_second_approval_threshold (rupees) | min_app_version (x.y.z). Unknown keys and badly typed values are rejected. Direct save; effectiveFrom now or later; returns { id, status: ACTIVE|SCHEDULED, effectiveFrom }.

Cancels a SCHEDULED change before it takes effect. Path kind can be payment | fees | app; use an id from scheduled[] (or settingId from a save). 204 on success, 409 ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION if already active, 404 if not found. Audited as SETTING_SCHEDULE_CANCELLED.
All admin accounts.
ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN. Every admin, including you and disabled admins: [{ id, email, role, status }]. Fetch once and cache for admin id -> email lookups (approvedBy, makerId, actorId, ...).
SUPER_ADMIN only. role: ADMIN | SUPER_ADMIN. Password must be at least 10 characters. displayName required (1-100 chars).
SUPER_ADMIN only. Sets displayName (1-100 chars, trimmed). Returns the updated admin.

SUPER_ADMIN only. Sets a new password (10-100 chars) for another admin, clears their lockout and revokes all their sessions. Returns 204. 403 FORBIDDEN on your own account (use Change my password). Audit ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET. Tell the admin the new password out of band.
